name: Parliament
desc:
The Parliament is a Boss that appears in [The Vat](location:the_vat), which is a Dungeon accessible through [The Gaunt Man](entity:the_gaunt_man). It is almost visually identical to a regular Deep Owl, with the only difference being that it resembles the head of [The Nestmind](entity:the_nestmind), as it is a Deep Owl with multiple heads.

This Boss is also encountered as a potential Power 6+ trial in [The Depths](location:the_depths), where it is significantly weakened.
